name: Trailer Fetcher
description: Finds and downloads missing local movie trailers from YouTube via yt-dlp.
overview: Finds and downloads missing local movie trailers from YouTube via yt-dlp.

versions.changelog: This plugin's own log entries (scheduled task runs, cookie upload/removal, etc.) now also get mirrored into their own file (plugins/Jellyfin.Plugin.TrailerFetcher/trailer-fetcher.log) via a scoped ILoggerProvider, so a run can be inspected without wading through the main server log. No change to what's logged, just where.
